en.title: Plural and inclusive pronouns
en.summary: We, you and they are the plural pronouns, and English has a single we for inclusive and exclusive use.

paragraphs: We, you and they are the plural subject pronouns. Some languages have two words for we: one that includes the listener and one that does not. English has only one, so the listener must work out which is meant from the situation. The same is true of you, which is both singular and plural.

The English we can include or exclude the listener, and the context decides. To be clear, add a phrase such as all of us, both of us or you and I. When the listener is excluded, a contrast with you often shows it. In Let's go, the contracted us always includes the listener.

blocks.html:
MeaningExample
listener includedWe should all go.
listener excludedWe are leaving; you stay.
made clearall of us, both of us
you and IYou and I are friends.
let's (always included)Let's start.

paragraphs: A king or queen may say we for I, and a writer may say we for I in an essay: We shall see that the claim is false. In ordinary speech this is rare or humorous.
The plural pronouns have object forms: us, you, them. We say They saw us and We saw them. After a preposition we also use the object forms: with us, for them.

items: Wrong: **Me and John went home.** Right: **John and I went home.**
Wrong: **Us are friends.** Right: **We are friends.**
Wrong: **Them live next door.** Right: **They live next door.**

ro.title: Pronume la plural și incluzive
ro.summary: Pronumele la plural sunt noi, voi, ei și ele, iar „noi” poate include sau exclude ascultătorul.

paragraphs: Pronumele la plural țin locul mai multor persoane: noi, voi, ei și ele. Limba română are o singură formă pentru „noi”. Acest pronume poate include sau exclude persoana care ascultă.

Limba română nu are pronume separate pentru grupuri incluzive sau exclusive. Pentru claritate, folosim cuvinte precum „toți”, „amândoi” sau „împreună”. La persoana a treia, folosim „ei” pentru masculin sau grup mixt și „ele” pentru feminin.

blocks.html:
FormăSensExemplu
noieu și alții (cu sau fără tine)**Noi** plecăm acum.
noi toțigrupul întreg, inclusiv tu**Noi toți** suntem aici.
voitu și alții (fără mine)**Voi** vorbiți românește.
eibărbați sau un grup mixt**Ei** cumpără pâine.
eledoar femei**Ele** dansează frumos.
